full_judgment: 18. It also appears that the plaintiff has got no grievance against Didarul Islam and his brothers as none of them is impleaded in the suit. He has not impleaded the school, for which admittedly 11 decimals of land or RS plot No. 2702 was acquired nor has brought said land in the hotchpot. In the circumstances, any claim of land on partition from the defendants may only succeed if the plaintiff can prove first, the defendants are still co-sharers with him and the land as described in the schedule-I is still joint.
